name: io.github.Crindo2/gth-mcp-server
title: GTH Intelligence — Substance Abuse Treatment Finder (API key required)
description: Paid MCP for 12,373 SAMHSA-verified addiction & mental health treatment facilities with insurance acceptance, service types, and contact data. Requires API key — subscription from $99/mo or $1.00/call PAYG. Get started at https://gettreatmenthelp.com/api-access/. Tools: search_facilities, get_facility_detail, list_states, get_treatment_types.
